origin: Independently fetched official upstream; no sibling workspace imports
scope: Canonical seeded prose/tasks, tokenizer calibration, prefix reply, cached-conversation depth tolerance and recalibration
rng: Independent C implementation of MT19937 and Python integer-seed, rejection sampling, 53-bit uniform and ties-to-even semantics; no CPython source copied
golden_generation: Offline developer extraction of selected definitions from the hash-verified pinned Python source; 22 prompt hashes, 35 primary request witnesses and independent boundary traces for four exhausted attempts, thinking, early prefix EOS and 1M client capacity. Product and CTest only read static JSON; no interpreter execution.
limits: CPU goldens prove protocol/text equivalence, not original-weight inference, numerical parity or GPU throughput. This port does not include the upstream server lifecycle, loading, vision or memory-peak qualification runners.
